description: P-SD: compares the channels of two polyphonic cables and sends out the voltages that are in one only, in both, and in the other only

params.text: Sets how far apart two voltages may be and be treated as the same, 0V to 1V; at 0V a tolerance of 0.00001V is applied anyway
Chooses whether voltages are compared as they are or as notes with the octave removed, marked v and the note symbol

inputs.text: One of the two cables being compared
The other of the two cables being compared

outputs.text: The voltages found in the A input and not in the B input
The voltages found in both inputs
The voltages found in the B input and not in the A input

notes: note mode rescales each voltage into a range of one volt before comparing, which removes the octave; it does not quantize to the nearest note
menu: Output duplicate voltages — keeps repeated voltages instead of sending each distinct voltage once
